original_text:
If I have an Data Engineering interview in the next month, my strategy would be:

- Go through all fundamental concepts of SQL.
- Solve 20-30 recently asked SQL queries.
- Solve 20-30 recently asked Python coding questions.
- Learn PySpark fundamentals.
- Understand RDDs, DataFrames, Datasets, and Spark SQL.
- Practice the top 20 PySpark programs.
- Revise Data Warehousing concepts.
- Understand the Data Model used in the project.
- Go through essential Linux commands.
- Learn how to explain your company’s project properly.
- Review the cloud services used in the project.
- Understand roles and responsibilities.
- Learn project implementation details.
- Go through common interview questions.
- Read blogs on interview experiences for the company you're applying to.
